messages:
Alex (sales): Hey team — large financial customer just asked whether we can run a 30-day on-prem POC in a fully air-gapped data center. No egress, no outbound telemetry, signed images only. They also want upgrade windows limited to quarterly and a clear rollback runbook. Can we scope what we need and any pricing implications?
Priya (SE): Short answer: yes, but a few caveats. We need to prepare a signed bundle + SBOM, offline activation flow, and a way for them to import root signing keys. Also need to confirm acceptable upgrade cadence and emergency hotfix process (they said quarterly + emergency patches during M+1 windows?).
Marta (Customer): Correct — our security team will only accept upgrades in scheduled quarterly windows. For critical CVEs we can allow one emergency patch per quarter with prior notice. Also need proof of chain-of-custody for images.
Jorge (eng): On the packaging side we can produce an immutable tarball with manifest.json + detached signature. Typical layout: 

```
bundle.tar.gz
  |-- manifest.json
  |-- runtime/...
  |-- models/...
  |-- sbom.json
  |-- signatures/manifest.sig
```

Verification is done offline via our `redwood-verify` tool. Example: `redwood-verify --bundle bundle.tar.gz --pubkey vendor.pub` or standard `sha256sum` to check checksums. We can include a signed SBOM (CycloneDX) and publish a signed SHA256 manifest.
Priya (SE): For upgrades we support two options: full-image replacement (preferred for air-gapped) or delta bundles (smaller, but requires more rigorous compatibility testing). Full-image simplicity = easier rollback (keep previous tarball on disk). Delta = faster transfers but higher risk. Which does customer prefer?
Marta (Customer): Simplicity wins for us — we want a clear rollback. So full-image bring-your-own-media (USB/sneakernet) is fine. We will also require a signed activation token for the POC that expires after 30 days.
Riley (pricing): Pricing implications: on-prem private deployment fee (one-time) + annual private support. For a POC we can offer discounted private-onprem trial: waive setup fee, bill for premium support/engineer days if we provide on-site assist. For quarterly upgrade SLA and offline signing support we need to add an "airgap support" add-on. Estimated: setup waived for POC, $X/day for on-call SE (TBD) — I can draft numbers after we confirm bundle size and patch cadence.
Jane (Legal): Security questionnaire items: we can provide SOC2 summary, data flow diagrams with egress disabled, and sample signing key handling procedures. We cannot share customer-specific HSM keys — we ship our public verification keys and a clear procedure to rotate keys. Also we need an NDA addendum for the POC image delivery chain-of-custody evidence.
Jorge (eng): Operational notes:
- Installer will run a preflight that checks for disk space, GPU compatibility, driver versions. Provide `preflight.json` output for their SRE.
- Rollback: keep previous bundle in `/opt/redwood/archives/` and a `redwood-rollback --to <bundle-id>` command. Test it in our staging to ensure DB migrations are reversible or versioned.
- Emergency hotfix flow: we will produce a signed hotfix bundle; customer must approve a short attestation before applying.

Priya (SE): Action items I can take now: 1) produce a POC checklist & runbook (staging -> image signing -> delivery -> activation -> rollback), 2) sample signed SBOM and manifest, 3) draft SOW language for POC support days.
Alex (sales): Sounds good. Can we also add instructions for validating signatures offline? Small snippet we can hand to customer: 

```
# verify signature
sha256sum bundle.tar.gz > bundle.sha256
redwood-verify --bundle bundle.tar.gz --pubkey redwood-prod.pub
```

Jorge (eng): OpsBot just created a ticket for the POC: POC-9876. (OpsBot: ticket POC-9876 created, assigned to Priya and Jorge)
OpsBot: Deployment checklist template attached: https://internal/redwood/templates/airgap-poc-checklist 
Priya (SE): I'll attach the sample manifest, SBOM, and runbook to POC-9876 by EOD. Also scheduling a technical kickoff with their infra team — Alex can you confirm times?
Alex (sales): I'll send a calendar invite for Tue 10am PST. Marta, does that work?
Marta (Customer): Tue 10am PST works. Please include our platform owner @leon. Also we need the SOW draft before kickoff so procurement can review.
Riley (pricing): I'll add draft pricing terms to the SOW: waived setup for the free POC, hourly SE rate if we do on-site, and optional airgap support add-on pricing.
Jane (Legal): I'll prep the NDA addendum and a redacted SOC2 package.
Alex (sales): Great — next steps summarized: Priya/Jorge prepare artifacts + runbook (POC-9876), Riley drafts SOW pricing, Jane prepares NDA addendum, Alex schedules kickoff. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
